daily.today_energy: Mercury's got your back today, Cap. Your practical energy is *chef's kiss* right now. Channel this grounded vibe into tackling that thing you've been putting off. The universe is basically saying 'you got this.'
daily.love: Whether you're coupled up or single, authenticity is your superpower today. Stop overthinking what you should say and just be real. The right people respond to genuine you, not the filtered version.
daily.career: Your ideas are hitting different today. That project or proposal you've been sitting on? The energy supports you sharing it. Trust your instincts—your mountain goat instincts are literally unmatched rn.
daily.health: Your body's asking for balance, not burnout. Move in a way that feels good (not punishing), and actually hydrate like your life depends on it. Small consistent choices > occasional extremes.

weekly.overview: This week's energy is inviting you to soften your edges, Cap. The universe is asking you to trust the process instead of controlling every outcome. Let go of perfectionism and see what unfolds when you actually rest.
weekly.love: Venus is whispering something tender your way. Whether you're coupled or solo, this is prime time for authentic connection. Show up as your real self, not the polished version you think people want to see.
weekly.career: Your professional vibe is shifting from hustle mode to strategic flow. Quality over quantity is the move. One focused project beats three half-hearted ones. Your competence speaks louder than your effort ever could.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for gentleness this week. Skip the extreme workouts and lean into activities that feel nourishing rather than punishing. Moving your body should feel like self-care, not self-sabotage.
